findings.claim: The battery optimization exemption is now an unconditional fourth gate on allPermissionsGranted, so on OEMs where the direct request dialog is blocked and no manual toggle exists, MainScreen becomes unreachable even with accessibility, overlay and notification access granted. The code itself anticipates OEMs blocking the dialog yet still hard-gates activation on the resulting state.
proof_refs: MainActivity line 152 folds isBatteryOptimizationExempt into allPermissionsGranted and line 154 only renders MainScreen when that conjunction is true, and the identical conjunction repeats at line 356 ahead of the all-permissions text.

MainActivity line 258 catches ActivityNotFoundException because some OEMs block the direct request dialog, falling back to the generic ignore-battery settings screen where the exemption may not be grantable at all.

On the refactor HEAD allPermissionsGranted required only isServiceEnabled, isOverlayEnabled and isNotificationListenerEnabled, so this squash newly blocks activation for any user who cannot obtain the exemption.
